subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 = 4,000 emails, within the 10,000 included. A Basic store adds USD 39 a month; the total is USD 39 before tax.
5,000 subscribers × 4 = 20,000 emails. (20,000 − 10,000) emails × USD 0.001 each = USD 10. A Basic store adds USD 39; the total is USD 49 before tax.
10,000 subscribers × 4 = 40,000 emails. (40,000 − 10,000) emails × USD 0.001 each = USD 30. A Basic store adds USD 39; the total is USD 69 before tax.
50,000 subscribers × 4 = 200,000 emails. (200,000 − 10,000) emails × USD 0.001 each = USD 190. A Basic store adds USD 39; the total is USD 229 before tax. Warm-up or caps may apply.
